**at** — точний час: *at 7 o'clock, at n:
**at** — an exact time: *at 7 o'clock, at noon, at night, at the weekend (UK)*
**on** — a day and a date: *on Monday, on 5 May, on my birthday*
**in** — a month, a year, a season, a part of the day: *in July, in 2024, in winter, in the morning*

- **for** + how long: *for two hours* · **since** + a moment: *since 2020*
- **during** + an event: *during the film*
- **by** — not later than · **until** — all the time up to
- **in** + a period = after that much time from now: *in ten minutes*
at + час · on + день/дата · in + місяць/: at + time · on + day/date · in + month/year/season
at — точний час і свята: at — an exact time and holidays
by / until — крайній строк чи «до кінця»: by / until — a deadline or “up to the end”
by — не пізніше ніж (дедлайн), until — д: by — not later than (a deadline), until — the action goes on right up to that moment.
for + період · since + момент · by (дедл: for + period · since + moment · by (deadline) · until (up to the end)
for + тривалість (for two hours), since: for + how long (for two hours), since + the starting point (since Monday).
for / since — скільки триває: for / since — how long it lasts
in + період — «через»: in + a period — “after that much time”
next, last, this, every, tomorrow, yeste: next, last, this, every, tomorrow, yesterday — without at/on/in.
on — день і дата: on — a day and a date
«Через 10 хвилин» від зараз — in, а не a: “10 minutes from now” — in, not after.
Please answer no later than Thursday.
At any time, but not later than 5.
Година, «вночі», вихідні (у британській): A clock time, “at night”, the weekend (in British English), holidays without the word day.
Days of the week and dates — always on.
Дні тижня, дати, конкретний день з части: Days of the week, dates, a specific day with a part of the day.
The report must be ready no later than 5.
Коли щось станеться в майбутньому, рахую: When something will happen in the future, counting from now.
On weekdays the shop opens at 9.
We usually go to Odesa in August.
Місяць, рік, сезон, частина дня (in the: A month, a year, a season, a part of the day (in the morning).
We eat kutia on Christmas Eve.
Please send it no later than Thursday.
The name of a day — with on.
Оксана й Тарас одружилися у 2019 році, 1: Oksana and Taras got married in 2019, on 14 September.
Перед next / last / this / every приймен: We don't use a preposition before next / last / this / every.
Прийменники часу показують, КОЛИ щось ві: Prepositions of time show WHEN something happens or HOW LONG it lasts. The main three, at / on / in, go from exact to wide: a point on the clock → a day → a month, a year, a season.
While the event is going on.
Тривалість — for; since лише з моментом: How long — for; since only with the starting moment (since 2022). And the tense is Present Perfect.
I'll be in the office until 5.
I'll call you back in ten minutes.
Give me ten minutes and I'll return.
I started working here in March, and I still work here.
